{{< include latex-macros/macros.qmd >}}

**Joint [likelihood](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/intro-MLEs.html#def-lik) of data set**:
$\Lik \eqdef \p(\vY= \vy, \vD = \vd | \mX = \mx)$

**Marginal likelihood contribution of obs. *i* **: 
$\Lik_i \eqdef \p(Y_i= y_i, D_i = d_i | \vX_i = \vx_i)$

*[Independent](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/independence.html#def-indpt) Observations Assumption:*
$\Lik = \prod_{i=1}^n \Lik_i$

*[Non-Informative Censoring](intro-to-survival-analysis.qmd#def-noninformative-censoring) Assumption:* 
$T_i\ind C_i | \vX_i$

$$
\Lik_i \propto [\pdf_T(y_i|\vx_i)]^{d_i} [\surv_T(y_i | \vx_i)]^{1-d_i}
= \surv_T(y_i|\vx_i) \cdot [\haz_T(y_i|\vx_i)]^{d_i}
$$

**[Survival function](intro-to-survival-analysis.qmd#def-surv-fn)**:
$\surv(t | \vx) \eqdef \P(T > t|\vX = \vx) = \int_{u=t}^{\infty} \pdf(u|\vx)du = \expf{-\cuhaz(t|\vx)}$

**[Probability density function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-pdf)**:
$\pdf(t| \vx) \eqdef \p(T=t|\vX = \vx) = -\surv'(t|\vx) = \haz(t| \vx) \surv(t | \vx)$

**[Cumulative hazard function](intro-to-survival-analysis.qmd#def-cuhaz)**:
$\cuhaz(t | \vx) \eqdef \int_{u=0}^t \haz(u|\vx)du = -\logf{\surv(t|\vx)}$

**[Hazard function](intro-to-survival-analysis.qmd#def-hazard)**: 
$\haz(t |\vx) \eqdef \p(T=t|T\ge t,\vX = \vx) = \cuhaz'(t|\vx) = \frac{\pdf(t|\vx)}{\surv(t|\vx)}$

**[Hazard ratio](intro-to-survival-analysis.qmd#def-hazard-ratio)**:
$\defHR$

**[Log-Hazard function](#def-loghaz)**: 
$\loghaz(t|\vx) \eqdef \logf{\lambda(t|\vx)} = \loghaz_0(t) + \diffloghaz(t|\vx)$

*[Proportional Hazards Assumption](#def-pha):*

$$
\ba
\haz(t |\vx) &= \blue{\haz_0(t)} \cdot \red{\hazfactor(\vx)}
\\
\cuhaz(t |\vx) &= \blue{\cuhaz_0(t)} \cdot \red{\hazfactor(\vx)}
\\
\loghaz(t|\vx) &= \blue{\loghaz_0(t)} + \red{\diffloghaz(\vx)}
\ea
$$

Here and throughout this chapter, we color the
$\blue{\text{baseline hazard}}$ — the part shared by every covariate
pattern — and the $\red{\text{covariate hazard ratio}}$ — the part
specific to $\vx$ — so the eye can follow each piece through the algebra.


*Logarithmic Link Function Assumption:*

- **Link function**: 
  $$\logf{\haz(t|\vx)} = \loghaz(t|\vx)$$
  $$\logf{\hazfactor(\vx)} = \diffloghaz(\vx)$$
  
- **Inverse link function**: 
  $$\haz(t|\vx) = \expf{\loghaz(t|\vx)}$$
  $$\hazfactor(\vx) = \expf{\diffloghaz(\vx)}$$
  

**Linear Predictor Component**: 

  $$\loghaz(t|\vx) = \loghaz_0(t) + \diffloghaz(t|\vx)$$
  $$\diffloghaz(t|\vx) = \reglincomb$$

*Linear Predictor Component Functional Form Assumption:*

$$\diffloghaz(t|\vx) = \reglincomb \eqdef \beta_1 x_1 + \cdots + \beta_p x_p$$
